raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "2-D cantilever domain",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 and Table 1 give no in-plane dimensions or aspect ratio. Sec. 4.5 fixes the longest side at 1 mm. Let L be the span and H the in-plane height.",
      "readings": [
        "Rectangular domain with L = 1 mm and H = 0.5 mm.",
        "Rectangular domain with L = 1 mm and H = 1/3 mm.",
        "Rectangular domain with L = 1 mm and H = 0.25 mm."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "uniform thickness normal to the 2-D plane",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No thickness or unit-thickness convention is specified for Table 1. With the stated force interpreted as a total force, uniform thickness scales stiffness and compliance.",
      "readings": [
        "Thickness = 1 mm.",
        "Thickness = 0.1 mm.",
        "Thickness = 0.01 mm."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "clamped region of the cantilever",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Table 1 refers to boundary conditions graphically; Sec. 4.1 gives no support coordinates or extent. 'Cantilever' identifies a clamped end but does not specify its grid implementation.",
      "readings": [
        "Both displacement components fixed along the entire end edge.",
        "Both displacement components fixed only at the two end-corner nodes.",
        "Both displacement components fixed along the central half of the end edge."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "external loading on the cantilever",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The unavailable Table 1 boundary-condition graphic is the only example-specific indication of load location. Sec. 4.1 supplies no coordinates.",
      "readings": [
        "Load at the midpoint of the free end: x/L = 1, y/H = 0.5, measured from the lower clamped corner.",
        "Load at the lower corner of the free end: x/L = 1, y/H = 0.",
        "Load at the upper corner of the free end: x/L = 1, y/H = 1."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "spatial distribution and number of applied forces",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.5 states Force = 0.1 N, but the text does not specify whether Table 1 uses a point force, a loaded segment, or several simultaneous forces.",
      "readings": [
        "One nodal point force of 0.1 N.",
        "Uniform traction over the full free edge, with resultant 0.1 N.",
        "Uniform traction over a segment of length 0.1H centered at the load location, with resultant 0.1 N.",
        "Two simultaneous parallel forces of 0.05 N at y/H = 0.25 and 0.75 on the free edge."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "applied force vector",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The global force magnitude is specified, but neither Sec. 4.1 nor Table 1's textual content states its direction.",
      "readings": [
        "Transverse downward force: F = (0, -0.1) N.",
        "Axial force toward the free end: F = (0.1, 0) N.",
        "Oblique force: F = (0.1/sqrt(2), -0.1/sqrt(2)) N."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "non-design cells at supports or loads",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No passive-region specification is given for Table 1. Sec. 4.5 describes passive regions for other examples but does not establish whether the 2-D cantilever has solid attachment pads.",
      "readings": [
        "No passive cells; the whole rectangular domain is designable.",
        "A one-element-thick strip at the clamp and cells incident to loaded nodes are fixed solid, with their material counted in the 0.5 total-domain volume budget."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "2-D constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.5 specifies E and Poisson's ratio, but not plane stress versus plane strain. The energy and Lame-parameter formulas in Sec. 3.2.2 are explicitly introduced for 3-D problems.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress: stress normal to the plane is zero.",
        "Plane strain: strain normal to the plane is zero."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Table 1 structured-grid resolution",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No 2-D element counts are supplied. Sec. 4.6 gives only a greater-than-6000-point condition; the explicit meshes elsewhere concern other examples.",
      "readings": [
        "For L/H = 2, use 120 by 60 elements.",
        "For L/H = 2, use 160 by 80 elements.",
        "For L/H = 2, use 240 by 120 elements."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "2-D finite-element formulation and integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 names an external SIMP implementation and a common FE solver, but the supplied text does not describe the 2-D element interpolation or quadrature.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with 2 by 2 Gauss integration and one constant density per element.",
        "Nine-node quadratic quadrilaterals with 3 by 3 Gauss integration and one constant density per element."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "minimum density and void stiffness in the FE solver",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 gives the cubic interpolation used in the neural method, but does not specify the Table 1 SIMP density floor or FE regularization, including treatment of binary zero-density cells.",
      "readings": [
        "Allow rho = 0 with E = E0*rho^3; remove exact voids and treat disconnected loaded designs as infeasible.",
        "Impose rho_min = 0.001 and use E = E0*rho^3.",
        "Allow rho = 0 and use E = Emin + (E0 - Emin)*rho^3 with Emin/E0 = 1e-9."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "complete SIMP density-filter operator",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 specifies a density filter with radius 1.5 element sizes, but supplies neither its weighting kernel nor treatment of neighbors outside the domain.",
      "readings": [
        "Linear-distance weights within radius 1.5h, normalized over existing in-domain neighbors.",
        "Uniform weights within radius 1.5h, normalized over existing in-domain neighbors.",
        "Linear-distance weights within radius 1.5h, retaining the full-stencil denominator and treating outside-domain densities as zero."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial density field",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3 initializes a domain without giving a Table 1 density field. The uniform 0.5 initialization in Sec. 4.2 is explicitly for the 3-D example.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform initial density rho = 0.5.",
        "Initial densities alternating between 0.49 and 0.51 on an even-sized grid, preserving mean density 0.5.",
        "Initial density 0.75 in the lower half and 0.25 in the upper half, preserving mean density 0.5."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "structured-grid optimization update and move limit",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 cites the SIMP code without giving its update rule or move limit in the supplied text. The stated Adam settings apply to the neural networks.",
      "readings": [
        "Optimality-criteria updates with a maximum density change of 0.2 per iteration.",
        "Optimality-criteria updates with a maximum density change of 0.1 per iteration.",
        "MMA updates with a maximum density change of 0.2 per iteration."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "SIMP termination criterion",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 says 'default convergence criterion' without stating its tolerance, monitored quantity, or iteration cap. The explicit 2000 iterations concern DMF-TONN; Sec. 4.4's numerical stopping settings concern Top3D.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop when maximum element-density change is below 0.01, with a cap of 200 iterations.",
        "Stop when maximum element-density change is below 0.001, with a cap of 2000 iterations.",
        "Stop when relative compliance change is below 1e-4 for five consecutive iterations, with a cap of 2000 iterations."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
